atAGlance: Cánh gà chiên nước mắm is fish-sauce fried chicken wings, usually with garlic, sugar, fish sauce glaze, and lime or chili.
whatItIs: Cánh gà chiên nước mắm are chicken wings fried until crisp, then tossed in a sticky garlic, sugar, and fish-sauce glaze. They are salty-sweet, fragrant, and built for sharing.
howToEnjoy: Eat while the wings are still sticky-crisp. Use cucumber, herbs, rice, or a squeeze of lime to balance the salty-sweet fish-sauce glaze.
howLocalsOrder: Order cánh gà chiên nước mắm as a shared plate. Ask for less spice before the glaze is tossed, and ask for rice if you want the garlic fish-sauce coating to go further.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Cánh gà chiên nước mắm is a snack or shared plate driven by sticky-crisp wings, garlic, sugar, and fish-sauce glaze; it is louder than plain fried chicken.
goodToKnow: Nước mắm is the glaze here, not a side dip; it should cling to the hot wings with garlic and sugar.
